examples.text: taṃ ce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati

8303.synonym: anussāveti, āroceti, paññapeti, paññāpeti, byākaroti, sāveti

examples.text: ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhekalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ, kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti
aññaṃ ito ye-abhivadanti dhammaṃ, aparaddhā suddhim'akevalī te, evam'pi titthyā puthuso vadanti, sandiṭṭhirāgena hi te'bhirattā.

8305.commentary: (VIBHt) abhivadato'ti aho sukhaṃ, aho sukhan'ti vacībhedakarappattāya balavataṇhāya ahaṃ mamā'ti abhivadato.

examples.text: tassa taṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandī. nandisamudayā dukkhasamudayo, puṇṇā'ti vadāmi

tassa taṃ vedanaṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandī. yā vedanāsu nandī tadupādānaṃ, tass'upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā sambhavanti.
evañ'ca pana tathāgatā evarūpe mahesakkhe yakkhe abhivadanti. abhivadito sakko devānam'indo bhagavato indasālaguhaṃ pavisitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi.

8308.meaning1: should be welcomed; should be greeted

examples.text: yatonidānaṃ, bhikkhu, purisaṃ papañcasaññāsaṅkhā samudācaranti. ettha ce n'atthi abhinanditabbaṃ abhivaditabbaṃ ajjhositabbaṃ.
yadaniccaṃ taṃ n'ālaṃ abhinandituṃ, n'ālaṃ abhivadituṃ, n'ālaṃ ajjhositun'ti. tassa evaṃpaṭipannassa tabbahulavihārino āyatane cittaṃ pasīdati.

8310.meaning1: pays the highest respect; salutes respectfully

examples.text: vesāliyaṃ vane viharantaṃ, aggaṃ sattassa sambuddhaṃ, kokanad'āham'asmi abhivande, kokanadā pajjunnassa dhītā.

8313.meaning1: worthy of highest honour; to be saluted respectfully

examples.text: sabbaṃ niruttipathapāragataṃ sabuddhaṃ, buddhaṃ tilokatilakaṃ hatapāpadhammaṃ, dhammaṃ vimuttisukhadaṃ vihat'āghasaṃghaṃ, saṃghaṃ ca niccam'abhivandiya dakkhiṇeyyaṃ.

8316.meaning2: very best of clothing, choice clothes

8319.commentary: (DNa) yo disā abhivassatī'ti yo yaṃ yaṃ disaṃ yāti, tattha tattha devo vassati.

examples.text: sadāmattā hāragajā, missakā ca yasassino, thanayaṃ āga pajjunno, yo disā abhivassati.

ekam'idaṃ, bho gotama, samayaṃ todeyyassa brāhmaṇassa parisati par'ūpārambhaṃ vattenti, bālo ayaṃ rājā eḷeyyo samaṇe rāmaputte abhippasanno, samaṇe ca pana rāmaputte evarūpaṃ paramanipaccakāraṃ karoti, yadidaṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikamman'ti.
vuḍḍh'āpacāyino'ti gihissa vā tadahupabbajite daharasāmaṇere'pi, pabbajitassa vā pana pabbajjāya vā upasampadāya vā vuḍḍhatare guṇavuḍḍhe apacāyamānassa, abhivādanena vā niccaṃ pūjentassā'ti attho.

8322.meaning1: bowing down, rising from one's seat, respectful salutation and respectful conduct
8322.compound: dvanda (abhivādanā ca paccuṭṭhāna ca añjalikamma ca sāmīcikamma ca)
8322.commentary: (MNa) ācariyaṃ disvā abhivādanakaraṇaṃ abhivādanaṃ nāma. yasmiṃ vā disābhāge ācariyo vasati, iriyāpathe vā kappento tadabhimukho vanditvā gacchati, vanditvā nisīdati, vanditvā nipajjati, ācariyaṃ pana dūrato'va disvā paccuṭṭhāya paccuggamanakaraṇaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ nāma. ācariyaṃ pana disvā añjaliṃ paggayha sīse ṭhapetvā ācariyaṃ namassati, yasmiṃ vā disābhāge so vasati, tadabhimukho'pi tath'eva namassati, gacchanto'pi ṭhito'pi nisinno'pi añjaliṃ paggayha namassati'y'evā'ti idaṃ añjalikammaṃ nāma. anucchavikakammassa pana karaṇaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ nāma.
8322.sanskrit: abhivādana + pratyutthāna + añjalikarman + samyañc, samīcī + karman

examples.text: cattāro'me, mahārāja, vaṇṇā, khattiyā, brāhmaṇā, vessā, suddā. imesaṃ kho, mahārāja, catunnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ dve vaṇṇā aggam'akkhāyanti, khattiyā ca brāhmaṇā ca, yadidaṃ abhivādana-paccuṭṭhāna-añjalikamma-sāmīcikammānī'ti.

8325.meaning1: habitually respectful; in the habit of being reverential

examples.text: abhivādanasīlissa, niccaṃ vuḍḍh'āpacāyino, cattāro dhammā vaḍḍhanti, āyu vaṇṇo sukhaṃ balaṃ.

examples.text: yaṃ kiñci yiṭṭhaṃ va hutaṃ va loke, saṃvaccharaṃ yajetha puññapekkho, sabbam'pi taṃ na catubhāgam'eti, abhivādanā ujugatesu seyyo.
abhivādanasīlissa, niccaṃ vuḍḍh'āpacāyino, cattāro dhammā vaḍḍhanti, āyu vaṇṇo sukhaṃ balaṃ.

8330.meaning2: causes to salute; asks for greeting; asks for good wishes

8332.meaning1: should be bowed to; should be given respect
8332.meaning2: fit to be worshipped or honoured
8332.commentary: (MNa) abhivādetabban'ti abhivādan'ārahaṃ buddhaṃ vā paccekabuddhaṃ vā ariyasāvakaṃ vā.

examples.text: disvāna aññam'aññaṃ saṇṭhapesuṃ, ayaṃ kho, āvuso, samaṇo gotamo āgacchati bāhulliko padhānavibbhanto āvatto bāhullāya. so n'eva abhivādetabbo, na paccuṭṭhātabbo, n'āssa pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ.
samaṇaṃ mātā pitā bhātā, vandanti naṃ patiṭṭhitaṃ, samaṇ'īdha jātihīnaṃ, abhivādenti khattiyā'ti.
yadā, bhante, brahmā sanaṅkumāro devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ pātubhavati, na tassaṃ parisāyaṃ koci devo abhivādeti vā paccuṭṭheti vā āsanena vā nimanteti.

8334.meaning1: to bow down; to pay respect (to)
8334.meaning2: to bow down; to pay respect (to)
8334.commentary: (MNa) abhivādetuṃ upakkamiṃsū'ti vandituṃ upakkamaṃ akaṃsu. tato paṭṭhāya ca vassasatikatāpaso'pi tadahujātaṃ brāhmaṇakumāraṃ avandanto koṇḍito hoti.

examples.text: atha kho, assalāyana, satta brāhmaṇ'isayo asitaṃ devalaṃ isiṃ abhivādetuṃ upakkamiṃsu.

8335.meaning1: having bowed down; having paid high respect (to)

examples.text: atha kho ambapālī gaṇikā bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
atha kho therā bhikkhū yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
abhivādesi maṃ sā, devānam'inda, bhaginī, sarām'ahaṃ tassā bhaginiyā vacanaṃ.
sakkā ca tāvataken'eva balamattena abhivijinituṃ. abhivijina, mahārājā'ti, kin'ti naṃ kareyyāsī'ti? tam'pi mayaṃ, bho raṭṭhapāla, abhivijiya ajjhāvaseyyāmā'ti.

8342.meaning1: to win; to conquer; to defeat (something with)

examples.text: sakkā ca tāvataken'eva balamattena abhivijinituṃ. abhivijina, mahārājā'ti, kin'ti naṃ kareyyāsī'ti?

8343.meaning1: (of war) having won; having been victorious

examples.text: so kho ahaṃ, mārisa moggallāna, taṃ saṅgāmaṃ abhivijinitvā vijitasaṅgāmo tato paṭinivattitvā vejayantaṃ nāma pāsādaṃ māpesiṃ. vejayantassa kho, mārisa moggallāna, pāsādassa ekasataṃ niyyūhaṃ.

atha kho taṃ, ānanda, cakkaratanaṃ samuddapariyantaṃ pathaviṃ abhivijinitvā kusāvatiṃ rājadhāniṃ paccāgantvā rañño mahāsudassanassa antepuradvāre atthakaraṇapamukhe akkh'āhataṃ maññe aṭṭhāsi rañño mahāsudassanassa antepuraṃ upasobhayamānaṃ.
parosahassaṃ kho pan'assa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīr'aṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā. so imaṃ pathaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati.

8346.meaning2: begs, entreats; solicits (from); induces (to do something)

8348.meaning1: reaches a conclusion; makes a decision
8348.meaning2: goes through, finds out for certain; is sure

examples.text: te pucchanti, pucchitvā abhivitaranti, abhivitaritvā ekato uposathaṃ karonti. anāpatti.
sañciccā'ti jānanto sañjānanto cecca abhivitaritvā vītikkamo

8351.meaning1: details of the Vinaya; finer points of discipline; (comm) Khandhaka and Parivāra
8351.commentary: (ANa) abhidhamme abhivinaye'ti ettha dhammo abhidhammo, vinayo abhivinayo'ti catukkaṃ veditabbaṃ… vinayo'ti ubhatovibhaṅgo. abhivinayo'ti khandhakaparivārā.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, subhūti, bhikkhu dhammakāmo hoti piyasamudāhāro abhidhamme abhivinaye uḷārapāmojjo.

8352.meaning2: as to the Vinaya; as regards the discipline

8354.grammar: abs of caus of abhi vi √raj, caus, intrans (+abl)
8354.meaning1: having become detached (from); having become disinterested (in); having become dispassionate (towards)

examples.text: āyatiṃ vipākaṃ viditvā tadabhinivatteti. tadabhinivattetvā cetasā abhivirājetvā paññāya ativijjha passati.
akkodhañ'ca adhiṭṭhahi adāsi, dānañ'ca vatthāni sukhumāni succhavīni, purimatarabhave ṭhito abhivissaji, mahim'iva suro abhivassaṃ.
atha kho, mahārāja, ghaṭikārassa kumbhakārassa etadahosi, lābhā vata me, suladdhaṃ vata me, yassa me kassapo bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho evaṃ abhivissattho'ti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, saradasamaye viddhe vigatavalāhake deve ādicco nabhaṃ abbhussakkamāno sabbaṃ ākāsagataṃ tamagataṃ abhivihacca bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yam'idaṃ dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannasukhañ'c'eva āyatiñ'ca sukhavipākaṃ tadaññe puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇaparappavāde abhivihacca bhāsate ca tapate ca virocate cā'ti.

seyyath'idaṃ, nando vaccho, kiso saṃkicco, makkhali gosālo, etehi, bho gotama, acelakā mutt'ācārā hatth'āpalekhanā naehibhaddantikā natiṭṭhabhaddantikā na abhihaṭaṃ na uddissakataṃ na nimantanaṃ sādiyanti

8364.meaning1: invites to take; presents to take away

examples.text: tañ'ce aññātako gahapati vā gahapatānī vā bahūhi cīvarehi abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyya, santar'uttaraparamaṃ tena bhikkhunā tato cīvaraṃ sāditabbaṃ. tato ce uttari sādiyeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
bhikkhuṃ pan'eva kulaṃ upagataṃ pūvehi vā manthehi vā abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyya, ākaṅkhamānena bhikkhunā dvattipattapūrā paṭiggahetabbā.

8365.commentary: (VIN 1.4.1.7) abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyyā'ti yāvatakaṃ icchasi tāvatakaṃ gaṇhāhī'ti. (SNa) abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyyun'ti sudinnattherassa viya raṭṭhapālakulaputtassa viya ca kāyena vā satta ratanāni abhiharitvā vācāya vā amhākaṃ dhanato yattakaṃ icchasi, tattakaṃ gaṇhā'ti vadantā pavāreyyuṃ.

examples.text: tañ'ce aññātako gahapati vā gahapatānī vā bahūhi cīvarehi abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyya, santar'uttaraparamaṃ tena bhikkhunā tato cīvaraṃ sāditabbaṃ. tato ce uttari sādiyeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

tañ'ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhuṃ evaṃ carantaṃ evaṃ viharantaṃ rājāno vā rājamah'āmattā vā mittā vā amaccā vā ñātī vā sālohitā vā, bhogehi abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyyuṃ, ehi, bho purisa, kiṃ te ime kāsāvā anudahanti, kiṃ muṇḍo kapālam'anucarasi, ehi hīnāy'āvattitvā bhoge ca bhuñjassu, puññāni ca karohī'ti.
bhassarā surucirā yathā maṇī, nett'ahesum'abhinīlam'āyatā, te jarāy'abhihatā na sobhare, saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā.

8371.commentary: (SNa) gahaṇ'atthāya hatthaṃ pasāreti. (VINa) abhiharatī'ti so ce dāyako tassa taṃ bhattaṃ kāyena abhiharatī'ti attho

examples.text: sa kho so, bhikkhave, bālo abyatto akusalo sūdo sakassa bhattu nimittaṃ na uggaṇhāti, idaṃ vā me ajja bhattu sūpeyyaṃ ruccati, imassa vā abhiharati, imassa vā bahuṃ gaṇhāti, imassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
pavārito nāma asanaṃ paññāyati, bhojanaṃ paññāyati, hatthapāse ṭhito abhiharati, paṭikkhepo paññāyati.
upārambhaṃ na sikkheyya, khalitañ'ca na gāhaye, na-abhihare n'ābhimadde, na vācaṃ payutaṃ bhaṇe.
sac'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno abhiharati abhimaddati anupajagghati khalitaṃ gaṇhāti, evaṃ sant'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo akaccho hoti.

8373.commentary: (DNa) so abhiharatī'ti so taṃ sīlaṃ abhiharati, upar'ūpari vaḍḍheti. sīlaṃ me paripuṇṇaṃ, tapo āraddho, alam'ettāvatā'ti na vīriyaṃ vissajjeti.

examples.text: yato kho, nigrodha, tapassī cātuyāmasaṃvarasaṃvuto hoti, aduṃ c'assa hoti tapassitāya. so abhiharati no hīnāy'āvattati.
atha kho te licchavī tassā rattiyā accayena saccakassa nigaṇṭhaputtassa pañcamattāni thālipākasatāni bhatt'ābhihāraṃ abhihariṃsu.
ajātasattukumāro devadattassa gayāsīse vihāraṃ kāretvā nānaggarasehi tivassika-gandhasāli-bhojanassa divase divase pañca thālipākasatāni abhihari
mahayitvā sambodhiṃ, nānāturiyehi vajjamānehi, mālāvilepanaṃ abhiharitvā, atha rājā'm'anupāyāsi.

8377.meaning2: is brought; is offered; is served

8378.meaning2: being offered; being brought to offer

8379.meaning1: was brought; was offered; was served

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhu, rañño sato khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa caturāsītithālipākasahassāni ahesuṃ, sāyaṃ pātaṃ bhatt'ābhihāro abhihariyittha.

8380.meaning1: is brought; is offered; is served

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ, devadattassa, bhante, ajātasattukumāro pañcahi rathasatehi sāyaṃ pātaṃ upaṭṭhānaṃ gacchati, pañca ca thālipākasatāni bhatt'ābhihāro abhiharīyatī'ti. mā, bhikkhave, devadattassa lābhasakkārasilokaṃ pihayittha.

8381.meaning2: is excited; rejoices in the prospect of

8382.meaning2: is excited; rejoices in the prospect of

examples.text: ehi tvaṃ, tāta sudassana, bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ pariyāpuṇitvā mama bhatta-abhihāre bhāsa. ahañ'ca te devasikaṃ kahāpaṇasataṃ bhikkhaṃ pavattayissāmī'ti.
sa kho so, bhikkhave, bālo abyatto akusalo sūdo na c'eva lābhī hoti acchādanassa, na lābhī vetanassa, na lābhī abhihārānaṃ. taṃ kissa hetu?
tato ratyā vivasāne, gām'antam'abhihāraye, avhānaṃ n'ābhinandeyya, abhihārañ'ca gāmato.
ayaṃ puriso rañño paccatthikaṃ pasayha jīvitā voropesi. tassa rājā attamano abhihārama'dāsi. ten'āyaṃ puriso mālī kuṇḍalī sunhāto suvilitto kappitakesamassu, itthikāmehi rājā maññe paricāretī'ti.

8386.commentary: (THa) nibbānam'abhihāraye'ti, attānaṃ nibbānaṃ abhihareyya upaneyya, yathā naṃ sacchikaroti, tathā paṭipajjeyyā'ti attho. (SNPa) van'antam'abhihāraye'ti apapañcito gihipapañcena vanaṃ eva gaccheyya.

examples.text: ujumaggamhi akkhāte, gacchatha mā nivattatha, attanā coday'attānaṃ, nibbānam'abhihāraye.
sa piṇḍacāraṃ caritvā, van'antam'abhihāraye, upaṭṭhito rukkhamūlasmiṃ, āsan'ūpagato muni.
annaṃ pānañ'ca ādāya, khajjaṃ bhojjaṃ anappakaṃ, gehato nikkhamitvāna, uyyānam'abhihārayiṃ.

8388.meaning2: goes to, visits; takes oneself to; attains

examples.text: atha āgaccheyya suddakumāro susikkhito katahattho katayoggo kat'ūpāsano abhīru acchambhī anutrāsī apalāyī. bhareyyāsi taṃ purisaṃ, attho ca te tādisena purisenā'ti?

imehi kho, mahārāja, catūhi paṭisambhidāratanehi samalaṅkato bhikkhu yaṃ yaṃ parisaṃ upasaṅkamati, yadi khattiyaparisaṃ, yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ, yadi gahapatiparisaṃ, yadi samaṇaparisaṃ, visārado upasaṅkamati amaṅkubhūto abhīru acchambhī anutrāsī vigatalomahaṃso parisaṃ upasaṅkamati.

8397.meaning2: exclamation of horror; exclamation of fright; exclamation of aversion

examples.text: sītavātaparittānaṃ, hirikopīnachādanaṃ, matt'aṭṭhiyaṃ abhuñjiṃsu, santuṭṭhā itarītare.
tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū asakkaccaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjanti abhuñjitu'kāmā viya
